g.text: Corrected DBS benchmark: fresh results, no Stage 3 superiority
Dots: individual seeds. Diamonds: means. Whiskers: descriptive 95% bootstrap CIs; n=10 seeds on one model.
Compare methods within each stage. Stage 3 includes the no-stimulation control; its objective is a fitted QUBO, not a new neural simulation.
